newsitem.title: USA: Illinois jobless rate up slightly in December.
newsitem.headline: Illinois jobless rate up slightly in December.

text.p: The Illinois unemployment rate rose slightly in December to 5.1 percent from five percent in November, the state's department of employment security reported Tuesday.

Illinois had 315,654 jobless workers in December, compared to 309,054 in November, according to the department. In December 1995, the state's unemployment rate was 5.3 percent with 322,893 jobless workers.
The department also reported the number of people working in the state rose to an all-time high of 5.87 million.
